name: ViSNeRF
definition: A hybrid NeRF model combining explicit feature grids and implicit feature decoders to improve speed and quality for dynamic volumetric scenes, using a generalized factorization strategy on the NeRF to achieve a multidimensional representation with minimal increase in model size and GPU memory cost.
summary: ViSNeRF is a hybrid neural radiance field method that efficiently synthesizes dynamic volumetric scenes by factorizing representations into spatial and parameter tensors, enabling interpolation across adjustable parameters without retraining.
